debugLog.label: Debug log
debugLog.description: Recent client messages, to copy into a bug report. Kept in memory only; passwords are left out.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language of menus, dialogs and messages. Missing translations show in English.

notifyAboutMissingFeatures.label: Notify if a feature supported by the server is missing in my client
notifyAboutMissingFeatures.description: Shown once per server each time you open Webatrice.

startupTab.label: Startup tab
startupTab.description: Where you land after signing in. Reloading the page keeps the page you were on.

startupServer.label: Server
startupServer.description: The room opens when you sign in to this server. Signing in to any other server opens its lobby.
